subject: Procurement kickoff — align MAP, PO path & kickoff slot request
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Torres <evan.torres@stratusdata.com>, procurement@stratusdata.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01 09:12 -0700
Subject: Procurement kickoff — align MAP, PO path & kickoff slot request

Hi Evan / Stratus procurement team,

Congrats again on momentum here — excited to get your procurement intake and kickoff on the calendar so we can move from contract terms to vendor activation. To ensure a smooth onboarding, we want to align on a short kickoff call (30–45m) to review the mutual action plan (MAP), PO process, and required onboarding artifacts.

High-level agenda (30 min):
- Introductions & roles (owner + approvers) — 5m
- MAP: milestones + timelines for PO issuance, legal redline, and SOC2 questionnaire — 10m
- Operational checklist: onboarding form, billing contacts, sample PO, SOW attachments — 8m
- Success criteria & next steps (owner, dates) + Q/A — 7m

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Sep 2, 10:00–10:30
- Sep 2, 15:00–15:45
- Sep 3, 09:00–09:45

I attached our onboarding form and the PO template we typically send to customers to accelerate your internal PO creation. Please confirm which slot works or propose two alternatives.

Required attendees from Redwood: Karthik (procurement lead), Marissa (CS onboarding), and Ben (legal) if there are any contract clarifications. If Stratus will need additional reviewers (finance, vendor risk), please list names/emails so we can include them.

Attachment stubs: [Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF, 320KB)], [Attachment: PO_Template_Stratus.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)]

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Program Manager, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff — align MAP, PO path & kickoff slot request

Thanks Mina — appreciate the clear agenda. We can do Sep 2 at 15:00 PDT. Attendees from Stratus: Evan Torres (me, procurement lead), Priya Sharma (finance head, priya.sharma@stratusdata.com), and Luke Brennan (IT security, luke.brennan@stratusdata.com).

A couple quick items for the call:
- We typically require a vendor setup packet + W9 and proof of SOC2 (if available) before issuing a PO. Do you have a SOC2 cert link or SOC2 Statement of Applicability?
- Is the PO path standard Net30? We may need Net45 for this initial pilot.
- We'll also circulate our internal vendor risk questionnaire in advance — will that be OK for Redwood to review?

I can set a calendar invite once you confirm 15:00.

Best,
Evan
Head of Procurement
Stratus Data

Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff — align MAP, PO path & kickoff slot request

Perfect — Sep 2, 15:00 PDT works for us. Evan — invite would be great.

Quick answers ahead of the call so we can be prepared:
- SOC2: Redwood maintains SOC2 Type II — I'll drop the link and ServiceNow artifact during the call; legal can share the cert.
- Billing/terms: Standard offering uses Net30; we can agree to Net45 for an initial pilot on a one-off basis — finance will confirm.
- Vendor risk questionnaire: absolutely fine, please send it in advance and I will route to our security and compliance team for response.

Karthik — can you bring the procurement intake checklist and the PO request workflow? Marissa — will you bring the onboarding timeline and success criteria? Ben — please be available for contract clarifications/quick redline guidance.

Mina

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Evan Torres <evan.torres@stratusdata.com>, procurement@stratusdata.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01 13:48 -0700
Subject: Procurement intake checklist + PO process summary

Hi all — adding the intake checklist here so Stratus knows what we'll need to complete vendor activation. I've listed owners for each item and an expected target timeline we can confirm on the call.

Procurement intake checklist (owners / ETA):
1) Completed onboarding form (Redwood) — owner: Stratus (Evan) — ETA: within 3 business days
2) Signed PO referencing RDW-2026-0517 or purchase order number — owner: Stratus Finance (Priya) — ETA: 5–10 business days
3) W9 and tax docs — owner: Stratus (if US entity) or equivalent — ETA: 3 business days
4) Vendor Risk Questionnaire — owner: Stratus, sent to Redwood security — ETA: 2 business days after receipt
5) SOC2 attestation / cert — owner: Redwood (Ben) — ETA: provided during call or within 24 hours
6) Legal redline window — owner: Redwood legal and Stratus legal — target turnaround 3–5 business days after redline
7) Activation config: billing contact, SSO/SP metadata if required, API keys rotation plan — owner: Marissa/CS — ETA: 2 business days post-PO

PO process summary:
- Redwood issues invoice after activation (unless contract says otherwise).
- Typical Net30. For this pilot, finance is OK to accept Net45; we'll confirm in follow-up.
- Please include the purchase amount and billing address exactly as in the PO template attached earlier.

Attachment stub: [Attachment: Procurement_Intake_Checklist.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

I will be on the Sep 2 15:00 PDT call. Looking forward to the MAP alignment.

—Karthik Iyer
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
